## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the use case?

## Proposed solution

## Alternatives

Other approaches you've considered, and why they fall short.

## Scope note

designfit v1 is intentionally **one viewport** with **token + geometry + presence** checks. Responsive multi-breakpoint support and a perceptual VLM fallback are on the roadmap, not in v1. Please note how your request fits this scope (or why it warrants expanding it).
